module_summary: Odd-ratio clock divider: rising-edge and falling-edge mod-NUM_DIV counters each drive a phase register, ORed into a near-50% duty output clock.

anchors.name: clk_div
anchors.why: Divided clock output, OR of posedge and negedge phase registers

anchors.name: cnt1
anchors.why: Posedge mod-NUM_DIV counter controlling clk_div1 high/low phase

anchors.name: cnt2
anchors.why: Negedge mod-NUM_DIV counter controlling clk_div2 high/low phase

anchors.name: clk_div1
anchors.why: Posedge phase output, high for first half of cnt1 period

anchors.name: clk_div2
anchors.why: Negedge phase output, high for first half of cnt2 period

groups.name: output_combine
groups.description: OR of both phase registers forming the divided clock
